meta.title: A live RFQ: "Edit Evaluation Time": "Ok" with the values it opens with goes through

plan.title: Live RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Save

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Open the RFQ Settings action that launches the Edit Evaluation Time dialog.

args.goal: in the Edit Evaluation Time dialog, leave all fields at the values they opened with, click Ok, and stop when the dialog closes and the screen shows the save result

steps.note: Confirm the unchanged evaluation-time values and complete the save action.
Verify the expected success confirmation after saving.
